rules.when: The task involves reading or analyzing images, screenshots, charts, K-line graphs, or any visual artifact that must be inspected or described.
rules.why: Visual tasks use Dasein GPT-5.6 Sol, which has been verified to accept image input.

rules.when: The local time is Monday through Friday between 08:00 and 18:00 (daytime work hours) and the task is planning, design, strategy, analysis, investigation, or research that needs deeper reasoning.
rules.why: Captain directive: all non-visual planning tasks use Dasein GPT-5.6 Luna at high effort.

rules.when: The local time is Monday through Friday between 08:00 and 18:00 (daytime work hours) and the task is execution-stage work: writing code from a decided plan, running a defined experiment, performing a routine check, or any bounded implementation.
rules.why: Captain directive: all non-visual execution tasks use Dasein GPT-5.6 Luna at medium effort.

rules.when: The local time is outside Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00 (including weekends and nighttime) and the task is planning, design, strategy, analysis, investigation, or research that needs deeper reasoning.
rules.why: Captain directive: all non-visual planning, design, analysis, investigation, and research tasks use Dasein GPT-5.6 Luna at high effort.

rules.when: The local time is outside Monday-Friday 08:00-18:00 (including weekends and nighttime) and the task is execution-stage work with explicit decided steps.
rules.why: Captain directive: all non-visual execution tasks use Dasein GPT-5.6 Luna at medium effort.
